    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">为什么你的 0.01 秒倒计时看起来一卡一卡的？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 data-id="heading-0">🧑‍💻 写在开头</h1>
<p>点赞 + 收藏 === 学会🤣🤣🤣</p>
<div>
<div>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">抛弃 setInterval！用 requestAnimationFrame 实现毫秒级精准倒计时</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>从"时间漂移"到"帧级精准"，让你的倒计时不再"偷跑"或" lag"</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">前言：为什么 setInterval 不够用了？</h3>
<p>做过倒计时的前端都知道，用 <code>setInterval</code> 写个倒计时看似简单，但上线后总会收到奇怪的反馈：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>"倒计时怎么快了 2 秒？"</strong> —— 浏览器节流/休眠导致</li>
<li><strong>"切个 tab 回来时间不对了"</strong> —— 后台标签页 setInterval 被降频到 1s 一次</li>
<li><strong>"0.01 秒跳动不均匀"</strong> —— 16.6ms 的渲染帧 vs 10ms 的倒计时粒度不匹配</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// 传统方案的问题：时间漂移累积
setInterval(() =&gt; {
  remainingTime -= 10  // 假设 10ms 间隔
  // 实际可能 15ms 才执行一次，100 次后就漂移了 500ms！
}, 10)</pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<p><strong>核心矛盾</strong>：<code>setInterval</code> 是"基于调用"的，而我们需要的是"基于时间"的倒计时。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">requestAnimationFrame：帧级精度的时间守护者</h3>
<p><code>rAF</code> 的优势：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>与屏幕刷新同步</strong>：60Hz/120Hz 显示器自动适配</li>
<li><strong>后台标签页自动节流</strong>：切 tab 时暂停，切回来自动补偿</li>
<li><strong>高精度时间戳</strong>：<code>performance.now()</code> 微秒级精度</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">核心思路</h4>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">rAF 循环
  ↓
获取当前时间 performance.now()
  ↓
计算已过去的时间 = 当前 - 开始时间
  ↓
剩余时间 = 总时长 - 已过去
  ↓
更新 UI
  ↓
如果剩余 &gt; 0，继续 rAF</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">基础实现：毫秒级倒计时 Hook</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// composables/usePreciseCountdown.js
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

export function usePreciseCountdown(targetMs, options = {}) {
  const {
    immediate = true,
    onFinish = () =&gt; {},
    onTick = () =&gt; {}
  } = options

  // 状态
  const isRunning = ref(false)
  const isFinished = ref(false)
  const startTime = ref(0)
  const elapsed = ref(0)
  
  let rafId = null
  let pausedAt = 0 // 记录暂停时已过时间

  // 计算属性：格式化的剩余时间
  const remaining = computed(() =&gt; {
    const left = Math.max(0, targetMs - elapsed.value)
    return {
      total: left,
      seconds: Math.floor(left / 1000),
      milliseconds: Math.floor((left % 1000) / 10), // 取 0-99
      formatted: `${Math.floor(left / 1000)}.${String(Math.floor((left % 1000) / 10)).padStart(2, '0')}`
    }
  })

  const tick = (timestamp) =&gt; {
    if (!isRunning.value) return

    // 首次运行记录开始时间
    if (!startTime.value) {
      startTime.value = timestamp - pausedAt
    }

    // 计算已过时间（关键：基于时间差，而非累加）
    elapsed.value = timestamp - startTime.value

    // 触发回调
    onTick(remaining.value)

    if (elapsed.value &gt;= targetMs) {
      // 结束
      elapsed.value = targetMs
      isRunning.value = false
      isFinished.value = true
      onFinish()
      rafId = null
    } else {
      // 继续下一帧
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    }
  }

  const start = () =&gt; {
    if (isRunning.value) return
    isRunning.value = true
    isFinished.value = false
    // 恢复时重置 startTime，保持 elapsed 连续
    startTime.value = performance.now() - elapsed.value
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
  }

  const pause = () =&gt; {
    if (!isRunning.value) return
    isRunning.value = false
    pausedAt = elapsed.value
    if (rafId) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId)
      rafId = null
    }
  }

  const reset = (newTarget = targetMs) =&gt; {
    pause()
    elapsed.value = 0
    pausedAt = 0
    startTime.value = 0
    isFinished.value = false
    if (immediate) start()
  }

  onMounted(() =&gt; {
    if (immediate) start()
  })

  onUnmounted(() =&gt; {
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId)
  })

  return {
    remaining,
    isRunning,
    isFinished,
    start,
    pause,
    reset,
    elapsed
  }
}</pre>
</div>
<p>使用方式：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="countdown"&gt;
    &lt;span class="seconds"&gt;{{ remaining.seconds }}&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;span class="decimal"&gt;.{{ String(remaining.milliseconds).padStart(2, '0') }}&lt;/span&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;div class="controls"&gt;
    &lt;button @click="start" :disabled="isRunning"&gt;开始&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button @click="pause" :disabled="!isRunning"&gt;暂停&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button @click="() =&gt; reset(30000)"&gt;重置 30s&lt;/button&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;
import { usePreciseCountdown } from './composables/usePreciseCountdown'

const { remaining, isRunning, start, pause, reset } = usePreciseCountdown(
  60000, // 60 秒
  {
    immediate: false,
    onTick: (time) =&gt; {
      // 可以在这里发事件给父组件
      // console.log('剩余:', time.formatted)
    },
    onFinish: () =&gt; {
      console.log('倒计时结束！')
    }
  }
)
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;style scoped&gt;
.countdown {
  font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ff6b6b;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem;
}
.decimal {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: #ff8787;
}
&lt;/style&gt;</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">进阶：视觉优化与性能</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">1. 减少不必要的渲染</h4>
<p><code>rAF</code>&nbsp;每 16ms（60fps）调用一次，但如果只显示 0.01 秒（10ms）精度，可以节流渲染：</p>
<div>&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">// 在 tick 函数中加入渲染节流
let lastRender = 0

const tick = (timestamp) =&gt; {
  // ... 时间计算逻辑
  
  // 每 30ms 渲染一次（约 33fps），足够显示 0.01 秒
  if (timestamp - lastRender &gt; 30) {
    // 触发 Vue 响应式更新
    renderTime.value = remaining.value
    lastRender = timestamp
  }
  
  rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
}</pre>
</div>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">2. 后台标签页优化</h4>
<p>利用&nbsp;<code>visibilitychange</code>&nbsp;检测页面可见性，切回时自动校准：</p>
</div>
<div class="code-block-extension-header">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">const handleVisibilityChange = () =&gt; {
  if (document.hidden) {
    // 页面隐藏时记录时间
    pausedAt = performance.now()
  } else {
    // 切回时补偿时间差
    const drift = performance.now() - pausedAt
    startTime.value += drift // 调整起始时间，消除漂移
  }
}

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange)</pre>
</div>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">3. 数字跳动动画</h4>
<p>让倒计时更有"紧迫感"：</p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="countdown-container"&gt;
    &lt;transition name="flip" mode="out-in"&gt;
      &lt;span :key="remaining.formatted" class="time-text"&gt;
        {{ remaining.formatted }}
      &lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;/transition&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;style&gt;
.flip-enter-active, .flip-leave-active {
  transition: all 0.15s ease-out;
}
.flip-enter-from {
  transform: translateY(-20px);
  opacity: 0;
}
.flip-leave-to {
  transform: translateY(20px);
  opacity: 0;
}
&lt;/style&gt;</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">完整对比：rAF vs setInterval</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2149129/202605/2149129-20260509134931638-446498737.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-05-09_134701_530" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">实战场景：秒杀倒计时组件</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="seckill-countdown" :class="{ urgent: remaining.total &lt; 10000 }"&gt;
    &lt;div class="label"&gt;距离结束仅剩&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="time"&gt;
      &lt;span class="num"&gt;{{ remaining.formatted }}&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;span class="unit"&gt;秒&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="progress-bar"&gt;
      &lt;div class="progress" :style="{ width: progressPercent + '%' }" /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { usePreciseCountdown } from './usePreciseCountdown'

const props = defineProps({
  endTime: Number // 结束时间戳
})

const targetMs = computed(() =&gt; props.endTime - Date.now())

const { remaining, isFinished } = usePreciseCountdown(targetMs, {
  onFinish: () =&gt; {
    // 触发秒杀结束事件
    emit('finish')
  }
})

const progressPercent = computed(() =&gt; {
  return (remaining.value.total / targetMs.value) * 100
})
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;style scoped&gt;
.urgent .num {
  color: #ff0000;
  animation: pulse 0.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
}
&lt;/style&gt;</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">总结</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2149129/202605/2149129-20260509134954629-165920606.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-05-09_134709_326" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;适用场景：秒杀倒计时、验证码 60s 倒计时、游戏计时器、在线考试限时等任何需要可靠时间保证的场景。</p>
